name: reportshq/laravel
description: Reports that run inside your own Laravel application against your own database, plus an optional event forwarder.

suggest.illuminate/support: Required to use the service provider and the shipped listeners.
suggest.filament/filament: Required only for the panel plugin; everything else works without it.

repositories.comment: stacksjs/php-spreadsheets is not on Packagist yet. An application installing this package needs the same entry in its own composer.json, since composer reads repositories only from the root package.
